svg.aria-label: Senior backend engineer building real-time, event-driven systems that hold up in production. I design and run backends in Node.js, TypeScript and NestJS: PostgreSQL schemas and zero-downtime migrations, Kafka and RabbitMQ pipelines, Redis caching, Elasticsearch search and Socket.IO gateways. Today I own the backend of a multiplayer learning platform serving 200K+ concurrent sessions. Before that I built WhatsApp automation moving 1M+ messages a quarter, and EdTech services at PrepLadder.
